pages.title: h1 to h6 Headings
pages.content:
### Heading Elements

HTML provides six heading levels, from `<h1>` (highest level) through `<h6>` (lowest level).

Use headings to create a logical document hierarchy rather than choosing a heading because of its visual size.

callout.title: Key takeaway
callout.text: h1 to h6 Headings demonstrates a core HTML concept. Use valid structure, semantic elements, and accessible attributes where applicable.

pages.title: strong vs b Tag
pages.content:
### `<strong>` vs `<b>`

`<strong>` communicates strong importance to the content. `<b>` draws attention stylistically without adding the same semantic importance.
